# CreditBrain

> CreditBrain is an AI-powered credit card recommendation platform for Indian consumers. It helps users find the best credit card based on their spending patterns, income, and preferences — with tools to compare cards, simulate rewards, and calculate the true value of a card for their lifestyle.

## What CreditBrain Does

- **Personalized recommendations**: Enter your monthly spending across categories (travel, dining, groceries, fuel, shopping, etc.) and get a ranked list of credit cards optimized for maximum rewards.
- **Rewards calculator**: Compute exact points/cashback earned on any card for a given spend pattern.
- **Card comparison**: Side-by-side comparison of features, fees, rewards, and benefits across multiple cards.
- **Profit analysis**: Net annual value after fees — tells you the true worth of holding a card.
- **Card catalogue**: Full searchable database of Indian credit cards across all major banks and networks (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, RuPay, Diners Club).

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://creditbrain.in/) — Overview and entry point
- [Card Catalogue](https://creditbrain.in/cards) — Browse and filter all credit cards
- [Expense Profiler](https://creditbrain.in/expense-profiler) — Input spending habits to get personalized recommendations
- [Recommendations](https://creditbrain.in/recommendations) — Your AI-generated ranked card recommendations
- [Compare Cards](https://creditbrain.in/compare) — Side-by-side card comparison tool
- [Rewards Simulator](https://creditbrain.in/simulator) — Simulate rewards for a given spending scenario
- [Blog](https://creditbrain.in/blog) — Guides, tips, and analysis on Indian credit cards

## Blog & Guides

See [/blog](https://creditbrain.in/blog) for articles on credit card strategy, rewards optimization, and personal finance for Indian consumers.

## Data & Coverage

- Cards from: HDFC Bank, SBI Card, Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra, American Express, RBL Bank, IndusInd Bank, IDFC First Bank, Yes Bank, Standard Chartered, Citibank, and more
- Networks: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, RuPay, Diners Club
- Card tiers: Entry, Standard, Premium, Elite, Super Premium
- Reward types: Points, Cashback, Miles

## API

The public card catalogue API is available at `https://creditbrain.in/api/v1/cards` (JSON, paginated).

For a more detailed machine-readable version, see [/llms-full.txt](https://creditbrain.in/llms-full.txt)
